recent_changes.description: v5.0.3: Implemented Sync Delete (Synchronous Cloud Delete) to prevent deleted data exposure on Mobile App.
v5.0.2: Fix Zombie Data bug by disabling auto-pull in Sync Manager (switched to One-Way Push).
v5.0.2: Fix AUTOINCREMENT sequence conflict by resetting sqlite_sequence after Cloud Restore.
Passed Legacy Migration Logic Tests: Verified parsing of old/new prescription strings.

decisions_made.reason: Backward compatibility: App Mobile/Form cũ cần đơn vị tính (Viên, Hộp) để hiển thị đúng.
Quick fix để đảm bảo backward compatibility cho form cũ và mobile app mà không cần refactor lớn.
Prevent binary merge conflicts and secure patient data.
Prevent 'Zombie Data' (resurrection of deleted records) by disabling auto-pull. Cloud acts as backup/read-only for Mobile.
Ensure Mobile App doesn't see deleted records by waiting for Cloud delete confirmation before returning.
